responsibility: Implements SHORTREAL text I/O over explicit channels mostly by reusing the REAL I/O layer. It reads through RealIO into a temporary REAL and converts to SHORTREAL, and delegates floating, engineering, fixed, and adaptive-width output directly to RealIO, making it the short-real adapter rather than an independent parser or formatter.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the ShortIO pair: it contains the adapter bodies that read via RealIO into a temporary REAL and delegate writes to RealIO, whereas ShortIO.def only declares the SHORTREAL channel API.
